column1: # Session 26, RQ-COMP-05 pass D and RQ-COMP-04 third-party pass, --no-follow. The platform search tool still returns URL-less
# summaries (one s26 pilot, not repeated), and Apple's search / lookup / review-feed paths are robots-disallowed (s26 audit), so only
# pages with predictable public URLs on origins whose robots.txt allows them are read: G2 and Product Hunt product pages (public
# reviews) and Wikipedia articles (third-party company facts for Tier-B vendors whose own origin refuses us). Never the vendor's own
# denied origin, never a cache or archive of it. Reviewer names are never recorded; page text stays in the private directory.
